title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-17
lineage: Cass/1 -> HHb CDR 800 PRO via analog i/o; CDR>EAC>TLH(6)>FLAC
source: (FOB) Nakamichi CM-300s w/CP-4 Shotguns -> Sony WM-D6 -> WM-D6(M-Cass)

ai_review.summary: In‑your‑face front‑of‑house recording captures a high‑energy set with a smoking Truckin’ finish, Playin' in the Band opener and a wild China Cat > I Know You Rider jam.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its sunny West Coast vibe, tight first‑set finish on “Truckin’” and a spacey second set that launches with an explosive “Playin’ in the Band,” followed by an adventurous “China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider.”  The front‑of‑house NAK 300 shotgun rig paired with Sennheiser 441s and a Marantz CD‑330 deck delivers an exceptionally clear, punchy recording that lets every instrument be heard.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave five stars and highlighted both a stellar performance (energy, standout songs) and an excellent front‑of‑house recording with high fidelity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded via a front‑of‑house NAK 300 shotgun rig using Sennheiser 441 microphones and captured on a Marantz CD‑330 deck; reviewers note the sound is “in your face,” crisp, and lets every instrument be clearly heard.

standout_songs: Playin' in the Band (2nd set opener)
China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first‑set finish that almost segues into “The Other One,” followed by a spacey, exploratory second set that opens wide with “Playin'” and dives deep into improvisation.

band_member_comments.Bob: Reviewers note extra stuff Bobby (Bob Weir) throws in, highlighting his contributions during the jams.
